entities.summary: Paulo de Carvalho (b. 1947-05-15, Lisbon) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lisbon and Portugal. Known in the fields of portugal, composers & musicians, europe.
